description: A report script for item-wise sales history in ERPNext, including data retrieval, processing, and chart data generation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns, data, and chart data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves and compiles sales order data based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on filters.

methods.name: get_sales_order_details
methods.description: Executes SQL to retrieve sales order records.

methods.name: get_chart_data
methods.description: Generates chart data from the report data.
